description: Defines the QuicPingManager class which manages keep-alive and retransmittable-on-wire alarms for QUIC connections, including related delegate interface and internal deadline management.

classes.name: quic::QuicPingManager
classes.description: Manages keep-alive and path degradation detection alarms for QUIC connections, with configurable timeouts and callback delegate.

classes.name: quic::QuicPingManager::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for handling timeout events triggered by QuicPingManager alarms.

methods.name: QuicPingManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ping manager with connection perspective, delegate, arena, alarm factory, and context.

methods.name: SetAlarm
methods.description: Sets the alarm with current time, keep-alive mode, and in-flight packet status.

methods.name: set_initial_retransmittable_on_wire_timeout
methods.description: Sets the initial retransmittable-on-wire timeout duration.

methods.name: reset_consecutive_retransmittable_on_wire_count
methods.description: Resets the count of consecutive retransmittable-on-wire alarms.

methods.name: UpdateDeadlines
methods.description: Updates internal deadlines based on current time and connection state.

methods.name: GetEarliestDeadline
methods.description: Returns the earliest of retransmittable-on-wire and keep-alive deadlines.
